the-continental.speaker: James St. James / Eric Goode
the-continental.context: James remembers Arthur Weinstein's Continental; Eric says it was in the same building as his first club and tells the wire story
the-continental.quote: James: Like the Continental, wasn't it? It was Arthur Weinstein's - was that an after-hours? - Eric: So the Continental was in the same building as my club with no name. And I gave Arthur that space, but he was in the loading bay. And that's a whole other story. So Arthur did the Jefferson, which was in the Jefferson Theater, then the Continental.
